subject: NimbleCart pilot: dataset & prompt-pack exchange / MAP kickoff
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@nimblecart.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: NimbleCart pilot: dataset exchange & MAP kickoff

Hi Camila / Ben,

Thanks again for taking a call with our team yesterday. We’re excited to move forward with a 6-week pilot to validate search relevance and checkout assistant prompts powered by Redwood. To kick things off we’d like to: 

- Share a scoped evaluation dataset (product titles, anonymized user queries, labeled intent samples)
- Exchange a small prompt-pack (10 canonical prompts + expected outputs) for rapid A/B testing
- Agree a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and an acceptance gate (QA checklist)

High level asks from our side: short-term sandbox access (IP-restricted), a non-exportable ephemeral token for the prompt pack, and confirmation on retention (we propose 30 days). Can you share a rough MAP and any constraints Redwood needs?

I’ve cc’d Ben for ingest/ops details. Procurement will be looped when we land on terms.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Chen
Head of AI Initiatives, NimbleCart
[sticker: logo]

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@nimblecart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NimbleCart pilot: dataset exchange & MAP kickoff

Alex — great to meet you, excited to run this. Attached is a first-pass MAP draft that maps deliverables to owners and dates. Key points from Redwood: 

- Scope: ephemeral evaluation data (IDs redacted), prompt-pack limited to 10 prompts and 5 expected outputs each; usage limited to pilot environment only.
- Access: short-lived tokens (30d max) and sandboxed endpoints; IP allowlist required.
- Licensing: evaluation-only license, no derivatives/redistribution; prompt-pack marked as restricted.
- Security: we’ll provide SOC 2 Type II evidence and a connectivity checklist.

I’ve attached the MAP draft and a sample prompt pack stub for your review. Proposed kickoff milestone: week of 2025-05-12 with a mid-pilot QA gate at week 3 and a close/acceptance walk on week 6.

If that looks good, can you confirm the procurement contact and whether NimbleCart requires an NDA or SOW before we exchange artifacts?

Camila Reyes
Program Manager, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: nimblecart_map_draft.xlsx]
[Attachment: prompt_pack_sample.zip]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@nimblecart.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-05T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NimbleCart pilot: dataset exchange & MAP kickoff — ingest & ops notes

Quick technical follow-up:

- Ingest format: CSV (UTF-8), columns = product_id, title, normalized_query, label (intent/outcome). 
- Size limit for pilot ingest: 50k rows; larger sets require advance notice for batching.
- Retention and DRM: Redwood will enforce ephemeral storage for evaluation artifacts — we recommend a 30-day retention window post-pilot with automated deletion unless you ask for extension.
- Sandbox routing: we’ll provision a dedicated sandbox model route for the pilot; traffic will be isolated from production models.

Requests for NimbleCart: please provide an IP CIDR allowlist and a point of contact for data access. For procurement/legal: we usually accept a short SOW plus our standard MPA appendix (I can attach the minimal feed-forward checklist).

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: data_ingest_requirements.pdf]

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@nimblecart.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimblecart.com, CTI Manager <cti_manager@nimblecart.com>
Date: 2025-05-06T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NimbleCart pilot: dataset exchange & MAP kickoff — procurement + CTI looped

Thanks all — procurement and CTI on our side are now on the thread.

Procurement note: we’re fine with a short SOW and an evaluation-only license. I’ve attached the internal purchase guidelines; procurement will review Redwood’s MPA appendix and the DocuSign powerform once you share the final docs.

CTI note: we require the 30-day retention and IP allowlist; we also asked if Redwood can watermark outputs from the prompt-pack during the pilot for traceability. Is that feasible?

Alex

[Forwarded: procurement playbook attached by procurement@nimblecart.com]

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@nimblecart.com>, procurement@nimblecart.com, CTI Manager <cti_manager@nimblecart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-07T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NimbleCart pilot: dataset exchange & MAP kickoff — next steps and sign-off items

All — thanks for the clarity. Final next steps from Redwood: 

1) Camila to share MAP draft link and DocuSign SOW powerform by EOD 2025-05-08 (linked here: https://redwood.app/drive/nimblecart/MAP-draft).
2) NimbleCart to provide IP allowlist and procurement contact (procurement already cc’d).
3) Ben to provision sandbox route and ephemeral token once SOW is signed (30-day token window; can request a one-time extension).
4) Watermarking: we can insert a lightweight prompt-level watermark token for pilot outputs — it’s configurable and non-invasive for QA.
5) Acceptance gate: mid-pilot QA (week 3) with a checklist; final acceptance walk + data deletion/extension decision at week 6.

Tentative dates: kickoff 2025-05-12, mid-QA 2025-05-28, close review 2025-06-23. Please confirm and we’ll send the DocuSign link.

Camila Reyes
Program Manager, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
[Link: DocuSign powerform — https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=12345]
